minor_noble.name: Graduate Hire
minor_noble.desc: A good degree opens doors, but not very wide.

merchant_ward.name: Hired from a Startup
merchant_ward.desc: You moved fast and broke things. Now you must learn the rules.

veteran_officer.name: Laid-Off Manager
veteran_officer.desc: Your old team remembers you. HR would rather forget you.

archivist.name: Assistant's Helper
archivist.desc: You have read what others only whisper. You already know one secret goal.

returned_exile.name: Boomerang Employee
returned_exile.desc: You left once and came back. You know how this place works, and you have no friends. You already know one secret goal.

grey_pawn.name: The Sponsor's Pick
grey_pawn.desc: Someone arranged your hiring, and she expects you to pay her back.
grey_pawn.unlock: Find the Silent Sponsor in any career.

pressures.tyranny: You hold on so tight that people have started to avoid you.
pressures.envy_fame: Everyone is talking about you, and not all of it is kind.
pressures.entitlement: Your team now expects more than you can give.
pressures.envy_wealth: Your budget gets more attention than your advice.
pressures.weakness: People answer your requests with polite delay.
pressures.disrepute: Talk stops when you walk into a room.
pressures.desertion: There are empty chairs where your friends used to sit.
pressures.penury: People you owe have started to smile at you.

charm.label: Charm
charm.blurb: You win rooms with praise, shows and careful handling of egos.

meters.authority: How much people follow your lead.
meters.reputation: How leaders and colleagues see you.
meters.loyalty: Who will back you when it counts.
meters.resources: Budget, favours and the means to get things done.
